name: Next.js 15 & Server Actions Kit
author: Mintu Community
description: Next.js 15 App Router architecture, type-safe Server Actions with Zod, Route Handlers, metadata generators, and dev commands.
ai_rules: In Next.js App Router, default to Server Components for data fetching; only add 'use client' when client interactivity, state, or browser APIs are required.
When defining Server Actions, always validate input arguments on the server using Zod schemas before performing database queries or mutations.
Parallelize independent data fetches with Promise.all() to eliminate async request waterfalls.
